Harsha Vardhan Kondapalli
Hyderabad, India
ï LinkedIn — # harshavardhankondapalli1@gmail.com — H +919553610281 —
Professional Summary
ServiceNow Developer with 3.5 years of experience in administering, configuring, and customizing ServiceNow applications
across medium-to-large enterprise implementations. Hands-on expertise in Business Rules, Script Includes, Client
Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, and Service Portal development using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, and
REST/SOAP integrations. Experienced in implementing ITSM workflows including Incident, Problem, Change, and
Service Request management aligned with ITIL best practices. Adept at working in Agile environments, collaborating with
geographically distributed teams, and delivering solutions that improve operational efficiency and end-user experience.
Experience
Wipro
Jan 2024 – Present
ServiceNow Developer
Hyderabad, India
– Administered and customized ServiceNow platform for enterprise ITSM implementations, configuring Incident,
Problem, Change, and Service Request modules aligned with ITIL process standards.
– Developed and maintained Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and ACLs
using JavaScript to enforce data integrity, automate workflows, and control platform behavior.
– Built and customized Service Portal experiences using AngularJS-based widgets, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap,
improving end-user self-service adoption across departments.
– Designed and configured Notifications, SLAs, and Escalation rules to ensure timely ticket resolution and adherence to
service level commitments.
– Developed REST and SOAP-based integrations between ServiceNow and third-party platforms (monitoring tools,
Active Directory, email systems), enabling automated ticket creation and bi-directional data sync.
– Created Flow Designer workflows and Orchestration scripts to automate repetitive IT operations, reducing manual
intervention and improving incident response time.
– Performed system and integration testing, authored unit test cases, implementation plans, and technical
documentation for all customizations and deployments.
– Collaborated with Solution Architects and cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to gather requirements,
estimate effort, and deliver sprint-based releases on schedule.
Wipro
Sep 2022 – Dec 2023
Associate ServiceNow Developer
Hyderabad, India
– Supported configuration and administration of ServiceNow instances across development, QA, and production
environments, including update set management and instance cloning.
– Developed Client Scripts and UI Policies to control form behavior dynamically, improving user experience and data
quality on ServiceNow service catalog items.
– Configured Service Catalog items, Workflows, and Approval Policies for IT and HR service requests, reducing
manual processing time for recurring service requests.
– Assisted in building and maintaining CMDB (Configuration Management Database) integrations to support accurate asset
tracking and dependency mapping for change management.
– Participated in incident handling, root cause analysis, and post-release validation, contributing to platform
stability and service uptime across enterprise environments.
– Produced and maintained technical documentation including development specs, unit test cases, deployment runbooks,
and support guides for ongoing platform maintenance.
– Worked with geographically distributed teams and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate them into
technical solutions, and deliver iterative improvements to existing ServiceNow modules.
Key ServiceNow Contributions
ITSM Process Automation – Enterprise ServiceNow Implementation
– Led configuration of Incident, Change, and Problem Management modules for a large enterprise client, automating
assignment rules, notifications, and SLA tracking to reduce resolution time by 35%.
– Developed custom Business Rules and Script Includes to enforce business logic and reusable server-side scripting
across multiple applications within the same ServiceNow instance.
Service Portal Redesign & Self-Service Enablement

– Built responsive Service Portal pages and widgets using HTML, CSS, AngularJS, and Bootstrap, replacing legacy
CMS pages and improving self-service ticket submission by end users.
– Configured Knowledge Base integration within the portal to surface relevant articles during incident creation, reducing
ticket volume for common issues.
Third-Party Platform Integration via REST APIs
– Designed and implemented REST-based integrations between ServiceNow and external monitoring and cloud platforms,
enabling automated incident creation from infrastructure alerts.
– Configured MID Server and Integration Hub spokes to facilitate secure, reliable data exchange between ServiceNow
and on-premise enterprise systems.
